notes.title: EVAC Bravo Update 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for playing the Bravo so far! Here's an update to keep it fresh. We'll have more for you soon!
-Updated Health and Damage system with new sounds and visual feedback. Cockpit now flashes red at low health and displays visual damage.
-Added Hitmarkers and Killmarkers that change color depending on what you're firing at. Extra satisfying sound effects.
-Added NOS and Cargo Hook to the Flite Manual- Press F1 to access.
-Updated Heli sound and Heli Damage Sound. Muffled when in cockpit, more attack when in third person.

[b]-Enlarged your Pilot.[/b]
-Fixed Radio Tower parts being extremely heavy.
-Changed Minigun Sounds
-Fixed Survey Link
-Fixed Space Bar not working on button mash
-Fixed Flak Turret being extra chunky (twice as heavy as it was supposed to be).
-Reimplemented ramming damage- not very substantial, but it can be used to crash through crates.
